separation: Each worker had exclusive writable paths. The reviewer did not author the reviewed artifacts. Coordinator amendments to literature are identified in the integrated protocol.
existing_workspace: Initial status included unrelated deletions/renames, untracked study trees and media, and editor changes. These were preserved; no staging or commit was performed.
resource_use: Only lightweight audits, tests, rendering and notebook execution were performed. No new media download, paid API call or large model fit was needed.
scientific_boundaries: The frozen GAVD study and new post hoc audits are exploratory.
The low-motion diagnostic remains identified as post hoc.
Conditional calibration, new masked model fitting and external evaluation remain proposed.
No patient-level clinical validity, treatment effects or state-of-the-art superiority are established.
